issues.t: Engine burns oil from faulty piston rings
issues.sym: You need to add oil between changes, the low oil level warning comes on, blue-gray smoke may show at startup, and in bad cases the engine loses power or fails.
issues.why: The oil control rings on these 2.0L and 2.5L turbo engines can fail to scrape oil off the cylinder walls, so oil burns in the cylinders and carbon builds up on the pistons. A class action lawsuit covers 2013-2016 Volvos with these engines.
issues.next: Check the dipstick every fill-up and keep a log of how much oil you add. Ask a Volvo dealer for an oil consumption test; if it fails, the fix is new pistons and rings or a replacement engine.

issues.t: Fuel pump module stops working and engine stalls
issues.sym: The engine is hard to start, cranks without firing, or stalls while driving.
issues.why: Software in the central electronic module could fail to send the signal that runs the fuel pump control module. Separately, owners of 2010 models report failed fuel pumps that had to be replaced.
issues.next: Make sure recall 09V-343 (a software update) has been done. If it stalls again after that, have the fuel pump and pump control module tested.

issues.t: AWD system disabled warning (Haldex pump or coupling)
issues.sym: An "AWD service required" or "AWD disabled" message appears, and the car drives on the front wheels only. You may notice wheelspin in rain or snow.
issues.why: The electric pump in the Haldex all-wheel-drive coupling wears out or clogs, often because its fluid and filter were never changed. Wiring to the pump and the coupling controller can also fail.
issues.next: Have the AWD codes read. Often a new pump, filter and fluid change fixes it. Change the Haldex fluid about every 30,000-40,000 miles to prevent repeats.

issues.t: Oil leaks from vacuum pump and valve cover
issues.sym: Oil spots under the car, a burning oil smell after driving, or oil on the side of the engine near the front.
issues.why: On the 3.2L and 3.0L six-cylinder engines, the seals in the brake vacuum pump can blow out and the sealant under the valve cover weakens with age. The seal on the accessory drive shaft can also weep oil.
issues.next: Have the source of the leak found before oil drips onto hot exhaust parts. A vacuum pump seal kit is an option instead of a new pump.

issues.t: Hissing at idle from torn PCV diaphragm
issues.sym: A hissing or whistling sound at idle, rough idle, a check engine light for a lean condition, or oil leaks from seals.
issues.why: The crankcase ventilation (PCV) valve on the 3.0L turbo six has a rubber diaphragm that tears with age, causing a vacuum leak and pressure build-up inside the engine.
issues.next: Have the PCV unit checked if you hear hissing at idle. Replacing it early helps avoid pushed-out oil seals.

issues.t: Low oil level warning from faulty dipstick
issues.sym: You seem to be losing oil and an "Engine Oil Level Low" message or yellow warning light comes on.
issues.why: Volvo found that the oil dipstick on the 3.2L and 3.0L turbo engines could let oil escape from the crankcase. Service bulletin TJ30021 replaces the dipstick and updates the engine software.
issues.next: Top up the oil and ask a Volvo dealer to check whether bulletin TJ30021 has been done on your car.

issues.t: Sunroof drains clog and leak water inside
issues.sym: Wet carpet in the front footwells, water dripping from the headliner or A-pillar trim, a musty smell, or fogged windows.
issues.why: The tubes that drain rainwater from the sunroof tray clog with dirt and debris, so water overflows into the cabin.
issues.next: Clear the drains with compressed air or a trimmer line, and dry the carpet quickly to protect wiring and modules under the floor.

issues.t: Door won't lock or unlock with the remote
issues.sym: One door fails to lock or unlock with the key fob or button, or makes a buzzing noise when locking.
issues.why: The electric lock actuator inside the door latch wears out. It is one of the most common electrical repairs on Volvos of this era.
issues.next: Have the door latch tested. A new latch with actuator fixes it.

issues.t: 12V battery drains and car won't start
issues.sym: The car is dead after sitting a day or two, or shows "12V Battery Critical Charging Fault". Some owners say it must be driven often to stay charged.
issues.why: Software in the Google-based infotainment and control modules can keep systems awake after the car is parked, draining the 12V battery. Volvo has issued several service bulletins with software fixes.
issues.next: Have the dealer install the latest software and test the battery. Keep the car updated over the air, and use a battery maintainer if it sits.

issues.t: Center screen freezes, goes black or reboots
issues.sym: The touchscreen freezes, goes black, gets stuck on "infotainment system starting", or reboots while driving, taking climate controls and the backup camera with it.
issues.why: Software faults in the Google-based head unit. Volvo bulletins cover a screen stuck in recovery mode and other glitches.
issues.next: Try a restart by holding the home button. Then ask the dealer for the latest software; repeat failures may need a new head unit under warranty.

issues.t: Sensus touchscreen glitches and false alerts
issues.sym: Apple CarPlay drops out, the screen lags or freezes, or false messages pop up.
issues.why: Software bugs in the Sensus infotainment system used before the switch to the Google-based system.
issues.next: Restart the system and ask the dealer for software updates.

issues.t: Vibration or shudder when braking
issues.sym: The steering wheel or car shakes when you brake, and rear pads may stick.
issues.why: Volvo bulletins address brake shudder and sticking rear brake pads; the fix is usually new pads and sometimes rotors.
issues.next: Have the brakes inspected and ask about bulletin TJ36202.

issues.t: Front seat belt anchor cable can break (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no warning. In a crash the front seat belt may not hold the person in place.
issues.why: The steel cable that anchors the front seat belts to the seat can weaken from repeated bending and snap.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 20V-378 and have both front anchor cables replaced for free.

issues.t: Driver seat panel can release the seat belt in a side crash (recall)
issues.sym: No warning sign. In some side impacts the driver seat belt may come loose from the seat.
issues.why: The plastic side panel on the driver seat could push against and release the seat belt attachment.
issues.next: Check for recall 09V-445 and have the dealer modify the panel.

issues.t: Engine can stall suddenly from software fuel cut-off (recall)
issues.sym: The engine shuts off without warning while driving.
issues.why: The engine computer cut fuel too readily under certain conditions.
issues.next: Have the free software update under recall 10V-579.

issues.t: Driver airbag clockspring connector fault (recall)
issues.sym: The airbag warning light may come on. The driver airbag might not deploy in a crash.
issues.why: An intermittent fault in the connector of the steering wheel clockspring could cut the airbag circuit.
issues.next: Have recall 10V-489 done at a Volvo dealer.

issues.t: Underbody coating can damage fuel lines (recall)
issues.sym: A fuel smell or a fuel leak under the car.
issues.why: Hardened underbody coating could press into and wear through the plastic fuel lines.
issues.next: Have recall 12V-101 checked; leaking fuel is a fire risk.

issues.t: Seat wiring can disconnect and affect airbags (recall)
issues.sym: The airbag warning light comes on after moving the seat.
issues.why: The front seat wiring harness could come apart when the seat is adjusted, so airbags or belt tensioners may not work right.
issues.next: Have recall 12V-075 done.

issues.t: Airbag computer may fire belt tensioners by mistake (recall)
issues.sym: Seat belt tensioners or curtain airbags could go off without a crash.
issues.why: A defect in the airbag (SRS) control unit.
issues.next: Have recall 12V-439 done.

issues.t: Wipers run nonstop and lights can fail (recall)
issues.sym: The wipers keep running, and the turn signals, high beams or headlight switch stop working.
issues.why: A fault in the central electronic module that controls these functions.
issues.next: Have recall 13V-377 done; driving without signals or headlights is unsafe.

issues.t: Starter fuse can blow with stop/start (recall)
issues.sym: After an auto stop at a light, the engine may not restart.
issues.why: The starter motor fuse could blow from repeated stop/start use.
issues.next: Have recall 15V-555 done.

issues.t: Passenger seat belt buckle can come loose (recall)
issues.sym: The front passenger buckle may feel loose or separate from its mount.
issues.why: The stud holding the buckle could loosen over time.
issues.next: Have recall 16V-798 inspection done.

issues.t: Side airbags may not inflate in a crash (recall)
issues.sym: No warning. The seat side airbags might not deploy.
issues.why: The initiators that fire the side airbag inflators could fail.
issues.next: Have recalls 16V-918 / 17V-127 done.

issues.t: Emergency call may not send GPS location (recall)
issues.sym: Usually nothing noticeable. In a crash, the automatic emergency call may not tell responders where you are.
issues.why: A software error in the connectivity module.
issues.next: Have recall 18V-800 software update done.

issues.t: Fuel pump fuse can blow and stall the engine (recall)
issues.sym: The engine stalls or won't start.
issues.why: The fuse for the low-pressure fuel pump can fail.
issues.next: Have recall 21V-414 done; the dealer fits a new fuse.

issues.t: Automatic emergency braking may not detect obstacles (recall)
issues.sym: The car may not brake on its own for a person or car ahead.
issues.why: A software and hardware mismatch in the active safety module.
issues.next: Have recall 20V-144 software update done.

issues.t: Loose screw can lock the steering (recall)
issues.sym: The steering may suddenly bind or lock.
issues.why: A screw could fall into the steering gearbox.
issues.next: Have recall 23V-001 done.

issues.t: Tailgate lift struts can break in cold (recall)
issues.sym: The power tailgate struggles or a strut snaps loose with force.
issues.why: The tailgate lift arms can freeze and separate in cold weather.
issues.next: Have recall 19V-046 done for redesigned lift arms.

issues.t: Plug-in hybrid battery can short circuit (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no warning. Risk of fire when the battery is fully charged and parked.
issues.why: A high-voltage battery module can short circuit internally.
issues.next: Follow recall 25V-179 directions: don't charge the car until the dealer repairs it, and park outside.

issues.t: Gas engine may not start on plug-in hybrid (recall)
issues.sym: Once the hybrid battery runs low, the car loses drive power because the gas engine won't start.
issues.why: An engine control software error.
issues.next: Have recall 22V-793 software update done.

issues.t: Braking can drop out in one-pedal or B mode (recall)
issues.sym: While coasting downhill in B mode or one-pedal drive, braking may be lost.
issues.why: A brake module software fault on plug-in and electric Volvos.
issues.next: Avoid B mode and one-pedal drive until the dealer installs the recall 25V-392 software update.

issues.t: ABS and stability control may switch off (recall)
issues.sym: ABS, traction or stability control warning lights.
issues.why: A diagnostic error in the brake control module can disable these systems.
issues.next: Have recall 23V-012 done.

issues.t: Backup camera image may not appear (recall)
issues.sym: The screen stays blank or freezes when you shift into reverse.
issues.why: A software fault in the camera display.
issues.next: Have recall 25V-908 software update done (over the air or at a dealer).

issues.t: Front seat bolts may be loose (recall)
issues.sym: A front seat may feel loose or rock.
issues.why: Seat bolts were not tightened properly at the factory (a small number of 2018 models are also included).
issues.next: Have recall 25V-818 done.

issues.t: Curtain airbags may be assembled wrong (recall)
issues.sym: No warning. The side curtain airbags may not deploy properly in a crash.
issues.why: Some curtain airbags were misassembled at the factory.
issues.next: Have recall 10V-564 done.
